recorder._comment: Mirrors ilc-Audio-Recorder conventions. Files are named <job_id>_<suffix>.wav where job_id is YYYY_Mon_DD_HH:MM (the recording start, local time). The recorder's own defaults are L/R; this site renamed them in Settings -> Filename. List every suffix that has ever been used for a role.
recorder._min_service_comment: Recordings shorter than this are treated as tests, not services (e.g. 2026_Jan_21_00:23, a 9-minute midnight test).
recorder._level_comment: A channel is dead when it carries signal for less than min_live_share of the program window, or its 95th-percentile level is below dead_channel_dbfs (2026-07-26 sanctuary feed: live ~10% of the service). Below silent_dbfs on every channel the recorder captured nothing (2026-01-25: -91 dBFS throughout).

schedule._comment: Service times by era. Used by `service-trimmer schedule` to check that each recording window actually contains a service, and to recommend recorder schedule changes.

eras.label: single Sunday Divine Service
eras.source: inferred from the recordings: program audio starts 8-15 min after the 09:40 recorder start every week through 2026-09-06

eras.label: two Sunday Divine Services
eras.source: immanuelalexandria.org: 'New Sunday Schedule begins on September 13, 2026: 8:00 AM Divine Service, 9:15 AM Adult Scripture Study / Sunday School, 10:30 AM Divine Service'

vocabulary_prompt: A Sunday morning Divine Service at Immanuel Lutheran Church in Alexandria, Virginia. Terms: Scripture, Gospel, Epistle, Psalm, Corinthians, Thessalonians, Deuteronomy, Philippians, benediction, doxology, offertory, absolution, Eucharist, liturgy, catechism, congregation, hymn, narthex, lectionary, Advent, Lent, Epiphany, Pentecost, Evangelical Lutheran. The preacher is Pastor Christopher Esget of Immanuel Lutheran Church.

transcribe._model_comment: auto = small.en on a Raspberry Pi (ARM), medium.en on a PC. Or name one: tiny.en, base.en, small.en, medium.en.

mix._delay_note: auto = keep the whole measured offset, because these two channels are sample-locked (0 ppm) so the offset is pure pulpit->loft propagation. It varies per service (52.85 ms on 08-09, 51.3 ms on 02-08). An offset above acoustic_max_ms means a recorder genuinely started late; only that excess is removed.

sync._quiet_comment: A window is 'quiet' when it is this far below the channel's own 90th-percentile window level. Relative, not absolute: an absolute -50 dBFS gate rejected every window of a service recorded at low gain.

sermon._merge_gap_note: Keep merge_gap_seconds at 30. 120 merged the sermon FORWARD into a reception/baptism rite on 2026-08-09. Adjacent runs are instead offered as merged *candidates* and must win on liturgical evidence (closing formula near the merged end).
sermon._density_comment: Single-channel mode only: transcript speech density that counts as preaching.

edges._comment: Edge refinement: re-transcribe a few minutes around each candidate boundary with no VAD and read the liturgy precisely. The prompt must stay neutral -- putting liturgical sentences in it makes Whisper hallucinate exactly those sentences over hymns.
edges.prompt: A sermon preached at Immanuel Lutheran Church in Alexandria, Virginia, by Pastor Christopher Esget.

liturgy._comment: Regexes over a normalised transcript: lowercase, punctuation removed, apostrophes dropped, single spaces. 'kind' is reported as evidence. Validated against 21 services from 2026-02 to 2026-08.

opening.re: \bgrace (be )?(to you )?and peace\b.{0,80}?\b(jesus christ|our father|our lord)\b( amen\b)?

closing.re: \bpeace of (god|christ)\b.{0,140}?\bchrist jesus\b( our lord\b)?( (un)?to life everlasting\b)?( amen\b)?
\bkeep (and guard )?your hearts and minds in christ jesus\b( (un)?to life everlasting\b)?( amen\b)?
\b(forever and ever|now and forever|world without end|unto the ages of ages) amen\b

liturgy._rites_comment: Rites that can follow the sermon with no hymn between (confirmation, reception of members, installation, farewell blessing). The preacher's voice continues, so the acoustic pass merges them with the sermon; these phrases mark where the sermon ended. Seen 2026-05-31, 07-12, 07-26, 08-09, 08-23.
liturgy._before_sermon_comment: The Gospel reading precedes the sermon (4-11 min before it in 17 of 21 services checked). Used only to score candidates.

before_sermon.re: \bthis is the gospel of the lord\b

reel._voice_comment: gtts needs network access at build time. 'none' replaces spoken labels with tone cues (rising pair = start clip, falling pair = end clip).
